description: Canadian sales tax breakdown for an amount in a province or territory: GST, HST, PST, RST or QST with each rate and amount rounded to the cent, plus the total. Rates are looked up for the given date (default today), so historical changes such as Nova Scotia's 2025 HST cut are handled. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

date.description: Date the rates apply to, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today (UTC)

province.description: Two-letter Canadian province or territory code

name: canada_sales_tax
